defs.def: made of many different things or parts that are connected; difficult to understand 复杂的；难懂的

ex.s: With a 3D printer， a cook can print complicated chocolate sculptures and beautiful pieces for decoration on a wedding cake． Not everybody can do that﹣it takes years of experience， but a printer makes it easy． A restaurant  in Spain uses a Foodini to "re﹣create forms and pieces" of food that are "exactly the same，" freeing cooks to complete other tasks． In another restaurant， all of the dishes and desserts it serves are 3D﹣printed， rather than farm to table．
ex.t: 有了3D打印机，厨师能打印复杂的巧克力雕塑和婚礼蛋糕上漂亮的装饰件。不是人人都能做到——那需要多年经验，但打印机让它变得简单。西班牙一家餐厅用Foodini“重现”食物的“形状和部件”，做到“完全一致”，解放厨师去完成其他任务。另一家餐厅所有菜肴甜点都是3D打印的，而非从农场到餐桌。
D．一些专家质疑3D食品打印。

ex.s: There' s nothing very complicated about this usage, a budget line is one of the lines in the budget, with the service or good to be purchased named and the cost quantified,
ex.t: 这种用法并不复杂，预算线就是预算中的一条线，注明要购买的服务或商品并量化成本，

ex.s: Living and working with others can sometimes be complicated, and humour makes this easier.
ex.t: 与他人一起生活和工作有时会很复杂，幽默会让这变得更容易。

ex.s: It was a writing system so complicated that, so far, no one has been able to interpret it completely.
ex.t: 这是一个非常复杂的书写系统，到目前为止，还没有人能够完全解释它。

ex.s: However, your choices affect your future in a way that is a lot more complicated than that.
ex.t: 但是，您的选择会以比这复杂得多的方式影响您的未来。

ex.s: I’m afraid the whole process is too complicated to explain in a few words.
ex.t: 恐怕整个过程太复杂了，无法用几句话来解释。
